en.headline: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory musical opens at Hong Kong Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Broadway adaptation of Roald Dahl’s story begins its Hong Kong run today at the Grand Theatre, with performances through 6 December.
body: The Broadway musical adaptation of Roald Dahl’s Charlie and the Chocolate Factory opens today at the Grand Theatre of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui.

Produced by Broadway International Group and presented in association with Broadway Asia and other partners, the show runs until 6 December. It is performed in English with Traditional Chinese surtitles and lasts about 145 minutes including a 20-minute intermission.

Daniel Plimpton plays Willy Wonka, with young actors alternating as Charlie Bucket. Tickets range from HK$388 to HK$1,288 depending on the date and seating category. The production features the chocolate factory’s rivers, Oompa-Loompas and familiar songs from the story.
Organisers said additional performances were added in December after strong demand. The Peninsula Hong Kong is the official hotel partner and is offering themed experiences linked to the show.

zh.headline: 《朱古力獎門人》音樂劇今起於香港文化中心上演
zh.dek: 改編自羅爾德·達爾作品的百老匯音樂劇，由今日起至十二月六日於尖沙咀香港文化中心大劇院公演。
body: 改編自羅爾德·達爾《朱古力獎門人》的百老匯音樂劇，今日起於尖沙咀香港文化中心大劇院上演。
製作由Broadway International Group負責，並與Broadway Asia等夥伴合作呈獻，公演期至十二月六日。演出以英語進行，附繁體中文字幕，全長約一百四十五分鐘，包括二十分鐘中場休息。
丹尼爾·普林普頓飾演威利·旺卡，小演員輪流飾演查理。票價由三百八十八元至一千二百八十八元，視乎日期及座位類別而定。舞台呈現朱古力河、隆巴小矮人等經典場景。
主辦單位指因反應熱烈，十二月加開多場。半島酒店為官方酒店合作夥伴，並推出與演出相關的主題體驗。
